children.name: Article Lead
children.text: Rebuild Gameplane on a clean cluster from a tested recovery set, then restore platform identity and worlds in a controlled sequence.

children.name: Article Callout Text
children.text: World snapshots alone cannot rebuild identities, roles, settings, audit state, module sources, or platform Secrets.

children.name: Section Body 1
children.text: Capture every versioned artifact, platform state source, credential, trust root, and ownership record required to rebuild.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 0
children.text: Include release, values, CRDs/specs, DB, Secrets/keys, sources, and panel DB + key.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 1
children.text: Include repository credentials, signing/CA, OIDC, DNS/TLS, and owner map.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 2
children.text: Set RPO/RTO, encryption, off-site copies, roles, and break-glass access.

children.name: Section Body 2
children.text: Prepare infrastructure first, install the matching release, then restore platform state before worlds.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 0
children.text: Prepare Kubernetes, storage, edge, certs, DB, registries, backups, monitoring.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 1
children.text: Restore DB/config only through its version-compatible procedure.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 2
children.text: Restore worlds to isolated servers, then reconnect endpoints and schedules.

children.name: Section Body 3
children.text: Compare the rebuilt environment to the recovery manifest and run scheduled isolated drills.

children.name: Quick Reference Line 1
children.text: 01  Release + values + DB + CRDs + Secrets + repositories + DNS/TLS

children.name: Quick Reference Line 2
children.text: 02  Rebuild dependencies → matching release → platform state → worlds

children.name: Quick Reference Line 3
children.text: 03  Rehearse on schedule; record achieved RPO/RTO and gaps
